name: my-patient
description: My Patient - US24 Solutions patient statement portal (React + Node.js + PostgreSQL)

scripts.install:all: npm install && npm --prefix backend install && npm --prefix frontend install && npm --prefix database install
scripts.db:reset: npm --prefix database run reset && npm --prefix backend run db:seed
scripts.dev: concurrently -n api,web -c cyan,magenta "npm --prefix backend run dev" "npm --prefix frontend run dev"
scripts.postinstall: npm --prefix backend install && npm --prefix frontend install --include=dev && npm --prefix database install
scripts.build: npm --prefix frontend install --include=dev && npm --prefix frontend run build
